name: Selection card
summary: Large clickable option with a title and an explanation. The whole card is the label of a native radio or checkbox.
use: Choices that need an explanation, like a payment method or a plan.
2 to 4 options the user must compare.
avoid: Short options without an explanation: use Radio or Checkbox.
More than 5 options: it takes too much space.
anatomy: Title, with an optional badge slot next to it.
Optional meta line: short facts, or the reason why the option is off.
Radio or checkbox at the top right.
Optional content slot below the option, inside the card.
figmaProps: Price or logo on the right, for example for delivery options.
Native slot next to the title with a Badge in it. Off by default.
Line below the explanation. Stays readable in Disabled. Off by default.
Native slot below the option: put an Alert, fields or links in it. Off by default.
reactProps: Required. Becomes the label of the input.
Price ("Free", "€2.95") or logo on the right. It is part of the label, so it is read out.
Slot next to the title, usually a Badge. Text and images only: it is read out as part of the description.
Slot for a line below the explanation. Stays readable when the card is disabled, so use it for the reason. Text and images only.
Slot for free content below the option, inside the card but outside the label: an Alert, extra fields, links, buttons. Pass null while it is empty to keep the slot open.
Fieldset with a legend. Always 1 column on mobile.
behaviour: Clicking anywhere on the card selects it. Chosen: brand background and a thicker border.
With content (children) the top part is the clickable option and the content below it is free: a click there does not change the choice.
An empty content slot takes no space.

Pattern "decoration method" (see Examples): a recommended option, an option that is not ideal with a warning and actions after you choose it, an option that is off with the reason, and a loading state with Skeleton. The rules live in your page, not in Selection card.
a11y: Native input inside a <label>. Title as the name; badge, explanation and meta as the description.
Content sits outside the label, so buttons and links in it work with the keyboard and a screen reader.
Always put the group in SelectionCardGroup (fieldset + legend).
Focus ring around the whole card.
content: Title: the choice in one to three words. Explanation: what happens when you choose it.
do: Keep the explanations about the same length, so the cards have the same height.
dont: Links or buttons in the title, explanation, badge or meta: they sit inside the label and catch the click. Put them in the content slot.
A disabled card without a reason.
